title: Explicit wide routing for reference-kernel signed GT BSGS

claims.statement: For uniform protected full-production fixed-G1 pairing-inversion challenges and independent fresh random hash bits, proof.md gives an explicit classical signed partial-range algorithm returning Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied P with success probability at least 0.4. Total computation on every challenge and coin outcome, including all failures and budget aborts, is at most 2^133.5 dense-Fp12 equivalents at C=20,000. Peak memory is at most 2^139 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^133.5 equivalents is included; no nonuniform advice is used. An explicit four-hop wide memory tree with fully charged ports/transfers, exact six-even-coefficient inverse-class keys, the actual protected pinned dense reference kernel with explicit charged tower conversion and normalization, exact signed coverage and a proven universal binary hash family with a charged work cap provide the success bound without heuristics. This analytic accounting control requires exponential resources and makes no practical execution or novelty claim.
